meta.source: Ministry of Finance Japan, JGB auction historical data workbook
meta.method: Per-auction total issuance = 'Offering Amount' (発行予定額) column, summed by issue-date ('発行日') calendar month across all coupon-bearing-JGB tenor worksheets. Treasury Discount Bills (sheet 'TB ') are excluded to match BOJ's own MD06 series, which tracks JGB and T-Bill outright purchases separately (see boj_balance_sheet.json 'operations').
meta.workbook_last_saved_note: MOF republishes this workbook periodically, not in real time — its internal save date typically trails the current date by several weeks, so the most recent 1-3 months here reflect whatever auctions had occurred by that snapshot, not the full calendar month.
